prerequisiteReview.judgement: Balanced equations and electronic-shell notation are the stated prerequisites, introduced in Principles and revisited with conserved atoms/charge and actual configurations here. New ratio/percentage/rate tasks supply all numerical inputs and calculations; no unstated industrial, logarithmic or advanced-metallurgy derivation is required.

coherenceReview.judgement: Source-topic order progresses from chemical families through air/reactions, reactivity and extraction to acids/salts/tests. The103 sections pair introductory explanations with worked and original fixed practice; labelled evidence lessons deepen transfer and controls. Every section is mapped to the exact complete source point set. Source facts, rounded reference values, invented data and schematic diagrams are distinguished; practical plans remain supervised descriptions without actual trials.

limitations: Whole authored written teaching only; no human examiner review, learner trials, performed practical competence or calibrated generative exam bank.
Other chapters and the paper archive remain incomplete. Zero exam-ready chapters or active exam templates; AI integration remains last.
